Fastest trains from Delhi to Agra Cantt, from the page I read (Thu 29 Oct not confirmed on it):

Vande Bharat 22470: Nizamuddin 6:00 AM → Agra Cantt 7:40 AM (1h 40m), CC/EC
Gatimaan 12050: Nizamuddin 8:10 AM → 9:50 AM (1h 40m), CC/EC
Shatabdi 12002: New Delhi 6:00 AM → 7:50 AM (1h 50m), CC/EC
Taj Express 12280: New Delhi 6:55 AM → 9:25 AM (2h 30m), CC/2S
Punjab Mail 12138: New Delhi 5:10 AM → 8:10 AM (3h), 1A/2A/3A/SL

The two fastest leave from Hazrat Nizamuddin, not New Delhi. The page cut off after the 11:15 AM departures, so later trains are missing. I could not see which days each train runs, so please check Thursday before you plan around one. Fares are not shown, and IRCTC blocked me.
